CH = knob channel number · FREQ = actual transmit/receive frequency in MHz · TONE TYPE = squelch filter: CTCSS = analog tone (Hz), DCS = digital code, None = no filter (everyone on that frequency hears you). R-* = RECEIVE side setting · T-* = TRANSMIT side setting. Two radios talk to each other ONLY if frequency AND tone match. Tap a row to copy the frequency into your radio programming app.
